assets.prompt: Use case: product-mockup. Image 1 is the user's ORIGINAL WEBSITE CONCEPT, the exact art-direction reference. Create ONLY a high-resolution standalone version of the book-and-tree illustration in its top-right hero. The other two images are exact Mo and Ella identity references. Keep proportions and natural hand-drawn mark-making of these sheets. Show an upright lavender book, almost front facing with subtle perspective and cream page edge, a large tree to the right and a few wildflowers/moss at its base. The title on the cover is exactly 'Ella’s Night Flight' in elegant dark brown literary serif over 2 lines, subtitle 'A Life of Mo Story'. Keep the book large and legible, 85% image height. The final asset must feel like the original concept illustration, not a reimagined fantasy scene.

Preserve the original character scale and identity, but avoid copying website UI. Cream #F8F3E5 outside the book, near invisible soft shadow. No exaggerated shadows, no artificial 3D page curvature, no dense glowing digital scene. No labels, no website text, no watermarks. Entire book occupies most of width with a small clear margin.

Use case: illustration-story. First reference is the original Life of Mo website concept. Recreate only its small founder-story woodland vignette (near the bottom, Mo sitting on a rock), as a standalone high-resolution landscape 2:1 artwork. Second reference is the exact Mo identity: round hedgehog, pale face, small black nose and eyes, russet scarf, scratchy graphite quills. Mo sits on a mossy rock at left beneath an old tree, looking with quiet curiosity at a few tiny golden fireflies, distant pines and a very pale lavender evening sky. Keep the original's airy, delicate watercolour and graphite style; plenty of light warm cream paper and loosely drawn wildflowers. Natural uneven edges dissolve into solid warm cream #F8F3E5 at all sides. A small intimate moment, not a dramatic vista. Same character identity as the supplied sheet, no invented accessories. No text, no frame, no circle, no website UI, no photographic rendering, no heavy digital glow.
